description: Takes two exports of the vendor master (for example last month and today) and matches the vendors by number, otherwise by name. Returns changed bank details (red, with a country change and a simultaneous e-mail change flagged as a typical fraud pattern), new vendors with gaps (no bank details, no VAT ID, account country differs from the registered country), bank details that now belong to two vendors, other changes (name, VAT ID, address, payment terms, block removed) and removed vendors. Bank details are shortened in the answer. Ends with the next step: call back on the known number, four-eyes countersignature, file the baseline. Pass two arrays (old_rows, new_rows) or one array rows with a version column (Old or New; German: Alt or Neu). For a single list use check_vendor_master. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

new_rows.description: New export with the same columns.

old_rows.description: Old export: vendor (number), name, iban, bic, vat_id, street, zip, city, country, email, payment_terms, blocked. German column names work too.

rows.description: Alternative to old_rows and new_rows: one list with a version column (Old or New) plus the columns above.

name: compare_vendor_master
title: Vendor master old against new: changed bank details, new and removed vendors, shared bank accounts, next step per case
